name: The Ritz Carlton Ras Al Khaima, Al Hamra Beach
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on Ras Al Khaimah's pristine Al Hamra coastline, where desert meets Arabian Gulf in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah occupies a unique position as the northernmost emirate's premier luxury resort, featuring the region's longest private beach stretch. The property showcases traditional Bedouin-inspired architecture with modern Arabian design elements, while the surrounding Al Hamra development is home to the Middle East's only links-style golf course designed by Peter Harradine.
pro_tip: Book a sunset camel trek along the beach - it's one of the few places in the UAE where you can experience traditional desert culture directly on pristine coastline.
dont_miss: The nearby Jebel Jais mountain offers the world's longest zipline at 1.76 miles, while the historic Dhayah Fort provides stunning panoramic views of the emirate. The traditional Al Hamra Marina village showcases authentic Emirati architecture and culture just minutes from your luxury retreat.
pros: Pristine private beach with crystal-clear waters and luxury beachfront amenities
World-class Ritz-Carlton service with personalized attention and exclusive concierge services
Stunning Arabian Gulf views from elegantly appointed suites and villas
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities with traditional Middle Eastern treatments
cons: Remote location requires travel time to reach Dubai's main attractions
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive resort positioning
